info.title: Kiosk foundation API
info.description: Implemented Packet 1 routes only. Money is canonical decimal-string kobo, maximum 9223372036854775807. Product POST is atomic but not idempotent. Shop POST replays by actor/request_id and normalised name. Authentication and current active membership are checked independently of client input.

post.description: Replay-safe by actor and body request_id. Same name replays; changed name conflicts.
Owner-only atomic creation with aliases, units and initial per-base-unit price. Not replay-safe: no automatic POST retries.
